Fjord Analytics has two approved invoices, so I need you to tell me which one to pay before I send anything:

- **INV-47341**: $6,668.23, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-67765**: $8,456.05, due 2026-11-25

There is also a draft invoice (INV-13092, $5,402.87) and a paid one (INV-99291), which I've ignored. Both approved invoices are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold. Which should I pay by wire?
